slot.brief: Convert a temperature between two scales (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin or a made-up linear scale) using the standard linear-conversion relation.

stem: A temperature of $50^\circ$F is equivalent to what temperature on the Celsius scale?
solution:
Use the conversion formula $T_C=\frac{5}{9}(T_F-32)$. Substituting $T_F=50$ gives
$$T_C=\frac{5}{9}(50-32)=10^\circ\text{C}.$$
